methods.label: Compare magnitudes and signs
methods.explanation: Additive inverses must differ only in sign. \(0.5\) and \(-1/2\) have the same absolute value and opposite signs. The pairs \(2\) and \(1/2\), and \(-3\) and \(1/3\), are reciprocals or are neither additive inverses nor reciprocals. Since \(-(-4)=4\), those two numbers are equal.
